ERC20 approve(address,uint256) entry point; calls _approve with _msgSender().

Splits contract token balance, swaps to ETH, pays marketing wallet and adds liquidity; guarded by lockTheSwap.
Approves router and executes swapExactTokensForETHSupportingFeeOnTransferTokens with block.timestamp deadline.
Approves router and calls addLiquidityETH with ETH value and block.timestamp deadline.

onlyOwner external ERC20 transfer of arbitrary token balance held by the contract.
onlyOwner ETH transfer of full contract balance to an arbitrary payable address.
onlyOwner ownership lock; sets _lockTime = block.timestamp + time and zeroes owner.
Restores previous owner when msg.sender matches _previousOwner and block.timestamp passes _lockTime.
Burns caller reflections by subtracting rAmount from _rOwned and _rTotal.

Internal fee-free transfer helper used by airdropArray loop.

edges.reason: msg.sender is passed as the sender into _transfer from transfer().
msg.sender is used as spender argument in _approve inside transferFrom.
msg.sender is the owner argument for _approve in approve().
deliver reads _msgSender() to pick the reflection balance to burn.
block.timestamp is used as the swap deadline, creating timestamp dependence.
block.timestamp is used as the addLiquidityETH deadline, creating timestamp dependence.
block.timestamp determines _lockTime in lock().
unlock() compares block.timestamp against _lockTime to restore ownership.
_owner is read and zeroed when locking.
_owner is reassigned from _previousOwner during unlock.
_previousOwner is checked against msg.sender and restored in unlock.
_lockTime gates the unlock reverting condition.
marketingWallet receives the ETH share computed in swapAndLiquify.
marketingWallet is the destination of the claimTokens ETH sweep.
uniswapV2Router is the target and WETH source for the swap.
uniswapV2Router receives the approval and addLiquidityETH call.
uniswapV2Pair is compared against from to avoid circular swap-and-liquify.
_maxTxAmount caps amount and caps contractTokenBalance in _transfer.
numTokensSellToAddToLiquidity defines overMinTokenBalance in _transfer.
inSwapAndLiquify guards against re-entering the swap from _transfer.
swapAndLiquifyEnabled gates the automatic swap call.
_isExcludedFromFee decides takeFee in _transfer.
_isExcluded values select the transfer branch in _tokenTransfer.
botWallets membership blocks sender/recipient in _tokenTransfer.
canTrade restricts senders before the trade flag is enabled.
_rOwned balances are subtracted and added in _transferStandard.
_tOwned is written for excluded accounts in the transfer variants.
from parameter drives validation and branch selection in _transfer.
to parameter drives validation in _transfer.
amount parameter is validated and forwarded to _tokenTransfer.
SwapThresholdAmount is scaled and stored into numTokensSellToAddToLiquidity.
time parameter is added to block.timestamp to set _lockTime.
walletaddress is the destination of the clearStuckBalance transfer.
contractTokenBalance is passed as the amount to swapAndLiquify.
takeFee selects fee removal and the transfer branch in _tokenTransfer.
half is the token amount passed to swapTokensForEth.
initialBalance is used to compute the ETH delta added as liquidity.
marketingshare is the value transferred to the marketing wallet.
transfer() delegates to _transfer.
transferFrom() delegates to _transfer before adjusting allowance.
_transfer calls _tokenTransfer after fee determination.
_transfer conditionally calls swapAndLiquify when the contract balance exceeds the threshold.
_tokenTransfer dispatches to _transferStandard for the default branch.
swapAndLiquify swaps half of the tokens for ETH first.
swapAndLiquify then adds the remaining tokens plus ETH as liquidity.
swapAndLiquify transfers the marketing share before adding liquidity.
claimTokens executes the ETH transfer to marketingWallet.
claimOtherTokens performs the arbitrary token transfer call.
clearStuckBalance performs the payable address transfer.
swapTokensForEth invokes the router swap with fee-on-transfer support.
addLiquidity invokes router addLiquidityETH with the computed ETH amount.
airdrop shares fee removal and transfer logic with airdropInternal.
airdropArray loops calling airdropInternal for each holder.

ETH forwarded to the marketing wallet during swapAndLiquify hands control to an external address mid-transfer, enabling reentrancy into the _transfer/_tokenTransfer flow; _maxTxAmount and state updates are not finalized before the external send.
claimTokens pushes ETH with transfer to an owner-controlled wallet before state is settled, allowing reentrant calls into privileged flows.
clearStuckBalance forwards the entire contract balance to a caller-supplied payable address, continuing execution after an external value transfer.

normalization_plan.reason: param_from is a positional argument of _transfer and should be folded into its function node.
param_to is a positional argument of _transfer and should be folded into its function node.
param_amount is a positional argument of _transfer and should be folded into its function node.
param_SwapThresholdAmount is stored by setSwapThresholdAmount and carries no independent semantics.
param_time only feeds _lockTime inside the lock function.
param_walletaddress is only used as the transfer destination in clearStuckBalance.
local_contractTokenBalance is a temporary computing the argument passed to swapAndLiquify.
local_takeFee is a transient branch selector inside _tokenTransfer.
local_half is a transient intermediate consumed by swapTokensForEth.
local_initialBalance is a transient snapshot used to size the addLiquidity ETH amount.
local_marketingshare is the value of the unsafe marketing wallet transfer and should be folded into that operation.
